command:
set -euo pipefail
project=$1; wt=$2; base=$3; head=$4; spec=$5; manifest=$6
tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -r -- "$tmp"' EXIT
for name in extra unknown flag; do
  set +e
  case "$name" in
    extra) bash "$wt/tests/test-resource-leases.sh" all extra >"$tmp/$name.out" 2>"$tmp/$name.err";;
    unknown) bash "$wt/tests/test-resource-leases.sh" unknown >"$tmp/$name.out" 2>"$tmp/$name.err";;
    flag) bash "$wt/tests/test-resource-leases.sh" --x value >"$tmp/$name.out" 2>"$tmp/$name.err";;
  esac
  rc=$?
  set -e
  test "$rc" = 1; test ! -s "$tmp/$name.out"; test ! -s "$tmp/$name.err"
done
test "$(/tmp/aosp-harness-tools-04/shfmt --version)" = v3.14.0
test "$(/tmp/aosp-harness-tools-04/shellcheck --version | sed -n "s/^version: //p")" = 0.11.0
/tmp/aosp-harness-tools-04/shfmt -d -i 2 -ci -bn "$wt/common/.harness/lib/resource-leases.sh" "$wt/tests/test-resource-leases.sh"
/tmp/aosp-harness-tools-04/shellcheck -x --severity=warning "$wt/common/.harness/lib/resource-leases.sh" "$wt/tests/test-resource-leases.sh"
bash -n "$wt/common/.harness/lib/resource-leases.sh" "$wt/tests/test-resource-leases.sh"
cmp "$wt/common/.harness/lib/resource-leases.sh" "$spec/prototypes/common/.harness/lib/resource-leases.sh"
cmp "$wt/docs/resource-leases.md" "$spec/prototypes/docs/resource-leases.md"
cmp "$wt/tests/test-resource-leases.sh" "$spec/prototypes/tests/test-resource-leases.sh"
test "$(git -C "$wt" diff --numstat "$base" "$head" | awk '{s+=$1+$2} END{print s+0}')" = 400
test "$(git -C "$wt" diff --name-only "$base" "$head")" = $'common/.harness/lib/resource-leases.sh\ndocs/resource-leases.md\ntests/test-resource-leases.sh'
test "$(wc -l < "$manifest")" = 7
test -z "$(git -C "$wt" status --porcelain)"
printf "INVALID=PASS rc=1 streams=0B cases=3\nSTATIC=PASS shfmt=v3.14.0 shellcheck=0.11.0 bash-n=2\nEXACT=PASS files=3 numstat=400 manifest=7 clean=true\n"

set -euo pipefail
wt=$1; head=$2
tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -r -- "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --no-local --quiet "$wt" "$tmp/full"
test "$(git -C "$tmp/full" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$head"
(cd "$tmp/full"; bash ./tests/test-resource-leases.sh >"$tmp/default.out" 2>"$tmp/default.err"; bash ./scripts/check.sh --offline >"$tmp/offline.out" 2>"$tmp/offline.err")
test "$(cat "$tmp/default.out")" = "RESULT PASS  resource leases"
test ! -s "$tmp/default.err"; test ! -s "$tmp/offline.err"
test "$(rg -c "^RESULT PASS  resource leases$" "$tmp/offline.out")" = 1
test "$(tail -n1 "$tmp/offline.out")" = "RESULT PASS  aosp-harness offline quality gate"
for f in common/.harness/lib/resource-leases.sh docs/resource-leases.md tests/test-resource-leases.sh; do test -f "$tmp/full/$f"; done
test -z "$(git -C "$tmp/full" status --porcelain)"; test -z "$(git -C "$tmp/full" diff --stat)"
printf "FULL=PASS head=%s default=%s lease-discovery=1 offline-last=%s clean=true\n" "$head" "$(cat "$tmp/default.out")" "$(tail -n1 "$tmp/offline.out")"

set -euo pipefail
wt=$1; head=$2
tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -r -- "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --depth 1 --quiet "file://$wt" "$tmp/depth1"
test "$(git -C "$tmp/depth1" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$head"
test "$(git -C "$tmp/depth1" rev-list --count HEAD)" = 1
test -s "$tmp/depth1/.git/shallow"
(cd "$tmp/depth1"; bash ./tests/test-resource-leases.sh >"$tmp/default.out" 2>"$tmp/default.err"; bash ./scripts/check.sh --offline >"$tmp/offline.out" 2>"$tmp/offline.err")
test "$(cat "$tmp/default.out")" = "RESULT PASS  resource leases"
test ! -s "$tmp/default.err"; test ! -s "$tmp/offline.err"
test "$(rg -c "^RESULT PASS  resource leases$" "$tmp/offline.out")" = 1
test "$(tail -n1 "$tmp/offline.out")" = "RESULT PASS  aosp-harness offline quality gate"
for f in common/.harness/lib/resource-leases.sh docs/resource-leases.md tests/test-resource-leases.sh; do test -f "$tmp/depth1/$f"; done
test -z "$(git -C "$tmp/depth1" status --porcelain)"; test -z "$(git -C "$tmp/depth1" diff --stat)"
printf "DEPTH1=PASS head=%s count=1 shallow=true default=%s lease-discovery=1 offline-last=%s clean=true\n" "$head" "$(cat "$tmp/default.out")" "$(tail -n1 "$tmp/offline.out")"

set -euo pipefail
wt=$1; head=$2
tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -r -- "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --depth 1 --quiet "file://$wt" "$tmp/depth1"
test "$(git -C "$tmp/depth1" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$head"
test "$(git -C "$tmp/depth1" rev-list --count HEAD)" = 1
test -s "$tmp/depth1/.git/shallow"
(cd "$tmp/depth1"; bash ./tests/test-resource-leases.sh >"$tmp/default.out" 2>"$tmp/default.err"; bash ./scripts/check.sh --offline >"$tmp/offline.out" 2>"$tmp/offline.err")
test "$(cat "$tmp/default.out")" = "RESULT PASS  resource leases"
test ! -s "$tmp/default.err"; test ! -s "$tmp/offline.err"
test "$(rg -c "^RESULT PASS  resource leases$" "$tmp/offline.out")" = 1
test "$(tail -n1 "$tmp/offline.out")" = "RESULT PASS  aosp-harness offline quality gate"
for f in common/.harness/lib/resource-leases.sh docs/resource-leases.md tests/test-resource-leases.sh; do test -f "$tmp/depth1/$f"; done
test -z "$(git -C "$tmp/depth1" status --porcelain)"; test -z "$(git -C "$tmp/depth1" diff --stat)"
printf "DEPTH1=PASS head=%s count=1 shallow=true default=%s lease-discovery=1 offline-last=%s clean=true\n" "$head" "$(cat "$tmp/default.out")" "$(tail -n1 "$tmp/offline.out")"

set -euo pipefail
wt=$1; base=$2; head=$3
tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -r -- "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --no-local --quiet "$wt" "$tmp/rollback"
test "$(git -C "$tmp/rollback" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$head"
git -C "$tmp/rollback" rm -q -- common/.harness/lib/resource-leases.sh docs/resource-leases.md tests/test-resource-leases.sh
git -C "$tmp/rollback" -c user.name=accept-review -c user.email=accept-review@example.invalid commit -q -m "test: rollback resource leases"
rb=$(git -C "$tmp/rollback" rev-parse HEAD)
test "$(git -C "$tmp/rollback" diff --name-status HEAD~1 HEAD)" = $'D\tcommon/.harness/lib/resource-leases.sh\nD\tdocs/resource-leases.md\nD\ttests/test-resource-leases.sh'
git -C "$tmp/rollback" diff --quiet "$base" "$rb"
(cd "$tmp/rollback"; bash ./tests/test-claude-session-lifecycle.sh >"$tmp/lifecycle.out" 2>"$tmp/lifecycle.err"; bash ./scripts/check.sh --offline >"$tmp/offline.out" 2>"$tmp/offline.err")
test "$(cat "$tmp/lifecycle.out")" = "RESULT PASS  claude session lifecycle"
test ! -s "$tmp/lifecycle.err"; test ! -s "$tmp/offline.err"
set +e; leases=$(rg -c "^RESULT PASS  resource leases$" "$tmp/offline.out"); rc=$?; set -e; test "$rc" = 1; test -z "$leases"
test "$(rg -c "^RESULT PASS  claude session lifecycle$" "$tmp/offline.out")" = 1
test "$(tail -n1 "$tmp/offline.out")" = "RESULT PASS  aosp-harness offline quality gate"
for f in common/.harness/lib/resource-leases.sh docs/resource-leases.md tests/test-resource-leases.sh; do test ! -e "$tmp/rollback/$f"; done
test -z "$(git -C "$tmp/rollback" status --porcelain)"
test "$(git -C "$wt" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$head"; test -z "$(git -C "$wt" status --porcelain)"
printf "ROLLBACK=PASS temp-commit=%s exact=3D diff-vs-base=0 lifecycle=%s lease-discovery=0 offline-last=%s clean=true implementation-unchanged=true\n" "$rb" "$(cat "$tmp/lifecycle.out")" "$(tail -n1 "$tmp/offline.out")"

set -euo pipefail
project=$1; wt=$2; next=04a-runtime-resource-lease-assurance
tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -r -- "$tmp"' EXIT
no_match(){ set +e; rg "$@" >/dev/null; rc=$?; set -e; test "$rc" = 1; }
find "$project/specs" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -name "*-$next" -printf "%f\n" >"$tmp/specs"
find "$project/work" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -name "*-$next" -printf "%f\n" >"$tmp/work"
test ! -s "$tmp/specs"; test ! -s "$tmp/work"
git for-each-ref --format="%(refname)" refs/heads/spec >"$tmp/refs"
no_match -q -- "^refs/heads/spec/[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-$next$" "$tmp/refs"
git worktree list --porcelain >"$tmp/worktrees"
no_match -q -- "^(branch refs/heads/spec|worktree .*)/[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-$next$" "$tmp/worktrees"
{ find "$project/specs" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -type f -name ledger.md -print; find "$project/work" -type f \( -name dispatch.tsv -o -name execution-base.env \) -print; } >"$tmp/records"
test -s "$tmp/records"
while IFS= read -r record; do no_match -qF "$next" "$record"; done <"$tmp/records"
test -z "$(find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name "aosp-harness-lease.*" -print)"
test -z "$(git -C "$wt" status --porcelain)"
printf "NEXT=PASS spec=absent work=absent refs=absent worktrees=absent records=%s-all-rc1 temp-residue=0 clean=true\n" "$(wc -l <"$tmp/records")"
